parts.text: Write a short company-wide announcement (under 120 words, English): from Dec 1, all expense reports must be submitted through the new system; paper forms will not be accepted after Nov 30.

**Subject: Important Update: New Expense Reporting System**

Dear Team,

Please be advised that starting December 1, all expense reports must be submitted through our new digital expense system. 

To ensure a smooth transition, please complete any pending claims in the legacy system soon. Effective December 1, paper expense forms will no longer be accepted. 

We will share login details, user guides, and training session links later this week. Please reach out to the Finance team if you have any questions. 

Thank you for your cooperation as we upgrade our processes.

Best regards,

Finance Department
